debug.description: Enable debug logging for detailed troubleshooting.

log_dir.description: Directory where neutron log files are stored.

log_file.description: Optional log file path. If empty, logs only to syslog.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

rpc_backend.description: RPC transport backend (e.g., oslo, rabbitmq, zmq).

lock_path.description: Path for file-based locking. Leave empty to use default.

api_bind_address.description: IP address the Neutron API listens on (default: 0.0.0.0).

api_port.description: Port number for the Neutron API service.

region_name.description: Region name used in service catalog lookups.

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the Neutron API service (0 = auto-detect).

api_threads.description: Number of threads per worker (leave empty for default).

db_reconnect_retries.description: Max number of retries when reconnecting to the database.

db_max_pool_size.description: Maximum connections per pool in the database connection pool.

db_max_overflow.description: Maximum overflow connections beyond the pool.

db_connection_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for establishing a database connection.

notification_level.description: Minimum level for emitting notifications (NONE disables them).

floatip_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for floating IP entries.

sg_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for security group rule cache.

allow_overlapping_ips.description: Allow tenants to use overlapping IP ranges (dangerous in production).

dhcp_agent_scheduler.description: Class path for the DHCP agent scheduler.

router_scheduler.description: Class path for the L3 router scheduler.

network_scheduler.description: Class path for the network scheduler.

quotas.description: Per-tenant resource quotas (key: resource name, value: limit).

default_floating_pool.description: Name of the default floating IP pool (if not using auto-allocation).

ml2_config_path.description: Optional path to ML2 plugin configuration file (if external).

l3_agent_config_path.description: Path to L3 agent configuration file (if separate).

dhcp_agent_config_path.description: Path to DHCP agent configuration file (if separate).

enable_isolated_metadata.description: Enable isolated metadata service for VMs in private networks.

enable_metadata_proxy.description: Enable metadata proxy for tenant network metadata access.

metadata_host.description: Hostname or IP of the metadata service (e.g., Nova metadata API).

metadata_secret.description: Secret key for metadata proxy authentication (required if enabled).

default_dns_domain.description: Default DNS domain appended to instance hostnames.

metadata_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the metadata service.

dhcp_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the DHCP agent.

l3_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the L3 agent.

keystone_authtoken.description: Keystone authentication settings for Neutron service.

project_domain_name.description: Project domain name for keystone v3.

user_domain_name.description: User domain name for keystone v3.

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for the Neutron service account.

username.description: Username for the Neutron service account.

password.description: Password for the Neutron service account (required for production).

signing_dir.description: Directory to cache signed tokens (v2 only).

oslo_concurrency.description: Concurrency and locking settings for Neutron processes.

lock_path.description: Directory for lock files (overrides global lock_path).

drivers.description: List of notification drivers (overrides notification_drivers if present).
